"The present application is filed under Section 389(1) Cr.P.C., corresponding to Section 430(1)
BNSS, 2023 seeking suspension of order of conviction dated 31.07.2025 in SC No.102 of 2024 on the file of the learned VIII Additional District and Sessions Judge-cum-Spec ial Judge for the trial of Offences against Women, East Godavari, at Rajamahendravaram.

entities.text: VIII Additional District and Sessions Judge-cum-Spec ial Judge
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Chidambaram, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner/AI and learned Additional Public Prosecutor representing the State.

Petitioner is A1 in SC No.102 of 2024 on the file of the learned VIII Additional District and Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge for the trial of Offences against Women, East Godavari, at Rajamahendravaram.

Learned counsel for the petitioner/AI would submit that the petitioner was found guilty for the offence under Section 376(2)(n), 417 & 312 IPC and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten (10) years and to pay a fine of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees five thousand only), in default,
shall undergo simple imprisonment for a period of two (02) years, for the offence under Section 376(2)(n) IPC and to undergo simple imprisonment for a period of one (01) year for the offence under 417 IPC and to undergo simple imprisonment for a period of two (02) years and to pay fine of Rs.2,000/- (Rupees two thousand only), in default, to undergo simple imprisonment for a period of six (06) months, for the offence under Section 312 IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the fine amount was remitted to the trial Court.
The petitioner was on bail during the trial and before and there is no violation of bail bond at any point in time.

He would further submit that the sentence imposed is for a fixed term of ten (10)
years and there is no possibility of hearing the Appeal in the near future.

He would submit that the trial Court without considering the fact that the appellant and the victim were in relationship for several years, erroneously convicted the appellant which is against the judgment of the Hon'ble Balla Nirmal Kumar vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 2 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192579968/
2

entities.text: Balla Nirmal Kumar vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Apex Court.
Therefore, there Is every likelihood for the petitioner to succeed in the Appeal.

Learned Additional Public Prosecutor opposed the present application by stating that there are no grounds to interfere with the judgment of the trial Court and therefore, the present application is unsustainable in law.

Considering the above facts and circumstances and upon perusal of the record, this Court is of the considered opinion that the order of sentence and imprisonment dated 31.07.2025 in SC No.102 of 2024 on A the file of the learned VIII Additional District and Sessions Judge-cum- Special Judge for the trial of Offences against Women, East Godavari, at Rajamahendravaram is hereby suspended, in respect of petitioner/appellant/ A1 alone, pending disposal of the Appeal,
subject to the following conditions:
(i) The petitioner/Accused shall be enlarged on bail, on executing a personal bond for Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand only), with two (02) sureties for a like sum each, to the satisfaction of the learned VIII Additional District and Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge for the trial of Offences against Women, East Godavari, at Rajamahendravaram.
(ii) On release, thepetitioner/ Accused shall appear before the learned VIII Additional District and Sessions Judge-cum- Special Judge for the trial of Offences against Women, East Godavari, at Rajamahendravaram, on every fourth Saturday of the month, till disposal of the Appeal (iii) The petitioner/Accused shall not leave the country without prior permission of this Court.
(iv) The petitioner/accused shall not intimidate or annoy the victim in any manner,
(v) The petitioner/Accused shall not involve in any of the similar offences in any manner,
(vi) If the petitioner/Accused violates any of the above conditions, the prosecution is at liberty to file an application seeking cancellation of the bail.

Accordingly, this application Is ordered."
 SD/.
WS.SRINIVAS  ASSISTAN^EGISTRAR  //TRUE COPY// SECTION OFFICER
